scalars.scalar_value: Experience performing data processing and analysis.

items.item_text: Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
Must be willing and able to travel.
Occasional evenings and weekends may be required.
This is a 100% limited position for 1 year with the possibility of extension or conversion to career status.
Theoretical knowledge of Mechanical Engineering or Physics as obtained through a related degree and one year of relevant work experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience performing data processing and analysis.
Strong computer skills including experience for data and image analysis (python, ImageJ, Origin or similar).
Demonstrated experience working in an academic research environment.

Under direct supervision of the Principal Investigator, the incumbent will assist with pulsed power-driven plasma experiments and will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the Rama facility. Incumbent will coordinate with the PI to design and carry out experimental research.

They will operate the pulsed power driver, relevant safety system and associated diagnostics, primarily pertaining to the diagnosis of wire load plasmas for high energy density physics research. The incumbent will carry out data processing and presentation of results to the PIs research team.
The incumbent may occasionally also visit and assist in experiments on pulsed power experiments at Cornell University, the University of Michigan or Sandia National Laboratories
Demonstrated ability to use cameras, optics, and lasers.
Demonstrated capability in the exercise of good experimental procedures.
Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills to maintain high-quality communication with PI and other lab members.
Demonstrated ability to work safely with high voltage equipment and pulsed power systems.
Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively in a team environment.
